narrative.details:
An incubus will be drawn to the hearts of lovers, and the most aching love will create the most irresistible lure.

My scrying has revealed two that should serve exceptionally.

In Silverpine Forest, Avelina Lilly provides her tailoring services to the fallen wizards at Ambermill. In the Barrens, Isaac Pearson hopes to make his mark in the seaside town of Ratchet.

They toil on opposite ends of the world, yet their hearts yearn only for each other. Bring those hearts to Carendin.
narrative.objectives: Bring the hearts of Avelina Lilly and Isaac Pearson to Carendin Halgar in the Temple of the Damned.
narrative.requestItemsText: Ah, adventurer, you return. Were you able to procure the lovers' hearts?
